name: stem-player
description: Personal, non-commercial local stem separation app with a 3D device mixer

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "npm:next:dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3001 electron ."
scripts.start: npm run next:build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
scripts.test:e2e: npm run next:build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron test/e2e/run.js
scripts.test:e2e:gpu-fail: npm run next:build && cross-env FAIL_GPU=1 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron test/e2e/run.js
scripts.pack: npm run icons && npm run next:build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run next:build && electron-builder --mac
